content.title: Adult Fashion Pose Ladder | Face, Hair, Gesture and Full-Body Return
content.summary: An adult perfume designer progresses from face and ring details to one complete ivory-suit portrait. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult original identity is established through face, hair, wardrobe and one small accessory. + Each detail interval adds one bounded identity proof and reconnects to the complete subject. + Age, facial geometry, hairstyle and body proportions remain stable across pose changes. + Seated, rear and turning views preserve garment seams, accessory side and studio lighting. + The terminal full-body view includes every previously proven identity anchor in one coherent portrait.
quick_start.recommended_input: Create one clearly adult original perfume designer with a silver-green blunt bob, amber eyes, an ivory wrap suit and a small cobalt ring inside a pale clay studio. Widen to the ring hand adjusting one lapel, then reconnect hand, face and both shoulders in a medium portrait before changing pose. Finish on a complete full-body stance beside one low cobalt plinth, with face, bob, wrap suit and ring all readable in the same frame.
required_anchors: One clearly adult original identity is established through face, hair, wardrobe and one small accessory.
Each detail interval adds one bounded identity proof and reconnects to the complete subject.
Seated, rear and turning views preserve garment seams, accessory side and studio lighting.
The terminal full-body view includes every previously proven identity anchor in one coherent portrait.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult perfume designer progresses from face and ring details to one complete ivory-suit portrait. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 先用面孔和薄荷色发型建立成年原创角色，再通过手部、肩部、坐姿和全身站姿逐级扩展；每个局部必须回连完整人物，服装、年龄和身体比例保持一致。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult original identity is established through face, hair, wardrobe and one small accessory.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult original identity is established through face, hair, wardrobe and one small accessory."

invariants.rule: Each detail interval adds one bounded identity proof and reconnects to the complete subject.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Each detail interval adds one bounded identity proof and reconnects to the complete subject."

invariants.rule: Age, facial geometry, hairstyle and body proportions remain stable across pose changes.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Age, facial geometry, hairstyle and body proportions remain stable across pose changes."

invariants.rule: Seated, rear and turning views preserve garment seams, accessory side and studio lighting.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Seated, rear and turning views preserve garment seams, accessory side and studio lighting."

invariants.rule: The terminal full-body view includes every previously proven identity anchor in one coherent portrait.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The terminal full-body view includes every previously proven identity anchor in one coherent portrait."

slots.name: lead_subject

slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
